implementation_summary: analysis-client.ts: getAuditResult(id, version?, fetchImpl?) and getPageContent(id, path, version?, fetchImpl?). They build paths with auditPath(AUDIT_API.get/content.path), add ?version= only for a positive integer, and send the page path as an encoded query value (encodeURIComponent). The calls follow the sibling audit-start-api.ts conventions: injectable fetch, a 15 s AbortSignal timeout, and nothing thrown. Every result is either {ok:true, reply} or {ok:false, error, code?}. error is the reply's own message, a plain sentence for a known code, or a fixed fallback. Raw error-page text is never passed on, unknown codes are dropped, an id that fails AUDIT_ID_PATTERN is refused without a fetch, and a malformed 200 reply becomes an 'unreadable answer' sentence. AnalysisScreen.tsx: AnalysisScreen({auditId, version?, fetchImpl?}) loads the version in an effect. It loads Page Content when a page is picked, and drops a late answer for a page that is no longer picked. Rendering goes to AnalysisView, which takes props only, so it can be tested without a DOM. The view has one h1 ('Website Audit analysis'), the URL and version line, and then these parts: HierarchyView; a Pages list of aria-pressed buttons, each saying 'Sample Page: checked itself' or 'Checked on its Sample Page <path>'; Skipped Pages with found/recorded/skipped counts, each listed as 'Not checked: <reason>' with a note that a Skipped Page is not a clean result; the picked page (a covered-page notice naming its Sample Page, PageFactsView, and Page Content loading/error/loaded); and FindingsList. Loading, error (role=alert), in-progress or stopped version, and empty pages/skipped/findings each have their own sentence. SKIP_REASON_TEXT is my own Record<RouteSkipReason,string> covering all 14 reasons, because lib/coverage-text.ts lacks depth-limit, excluded and payment.

risks: The test file is not type-checked: the wizard tsconfig includes only src. Fixture fields the view does not render (limits, internalLinking, edits, summary, marketing beyond signals) are cast.
The Page Content fetch keys on the path the user picked. If the runner normalises the path it replies with, the content still shows, because the match uses the requested path and not content.urlPath.

lib/coverage-text.ts skipReasonText has no wording for depth-limit, excluded or payment and shows them as 'Skipped'. AnalysisScreen uses its own complete map, so the two wordings for the same reasons can drift apart. That file is not in this task's ownership.
handoff: FE-191: mount <AnalysisScreen auditId={id} version={v} /> (version optional, defaults to the latest; fetchImpl is for tests only). The screen renders its own <main> and h1. AnalysisView is the pure renderer if a host needs to drive state itself. No page is picked at first; Page Content loads on the first pick.
